name: corezoid
description: Corezoid AI Documentation and Templates — skills and MCP server for working with Corezoid BPM processes.

interface.shortDescription: BPM process authoring and automation via the Corezoid API
interface.longDescription: Create, edit, review, and deploy Corezoid BPM processes directly from your IDE via the Corezoid REST API. Covers process authoring, linting, layout, documentation, environment variables, aliases, dashboards, access control, and state diagrams — including running tasks and inspecting task history by process ID, with no local process repository required. Also turns a set of existing processes into a multi-platform messenger bot — Telegram, Viber, Facebook Messenger and Apple Messages for Business — and maintains it as commands, copy and wiring change.
capabilities: BPM process creation, editing, and review
Push, pull, and deploy processes across stages
Run tasks and inspect task/node history by process ID
Process linting, auto-layout, and documentation generation
Environment variables, aliases, dashboards, and access management
Messenger bot generation and maintenance over existing processes (Telegram, Viber, Facebook Messenger, Apple Messages for Business)
defaultPrompt: Create a new Corezoid process that validates and stores a customer order
Review this process for orphaned nodes and hardcoded values
Run a task on process 123456 and show me the result
Turn processes 123456 and 123457 into a Telegram bot
